groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.text: How did John choose the topic of his research project?

options.t: He thought the information would be useful for town planning.
He has a special interest in the use of public services.
He read about a similar study which had been done earlier.

questions.text: During his research, John is expecting to find that

options.t: the use of public services has altered very little.
a group of people has changed its habits.
the most frequently used facility is the library.

questions.text: What is the problem with using official records?

options.t: They may be lacking in detail.
They may not be readily available.
They may be difficult to analyse.

questions.text: What does the tutor think about John using a questionnaire to get information?

options.t: He needs to do a course in questionnaire design first.
He should use this method instead of looking at public records.
He will find the practice he gets useful the following year.

questions.text: Which new variable does John agree to add to his investigation?

options.t: occupation
income group
qualifications

questions.text: How many questionnaires will John distribute?

options.t: the same number as in the previous study
a greater number than he needs for analysis
the number recommended in the project guidelines

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO strategies will John use to encourage people to fill out his questionnaire?

options.t: using simple language
delivering the questionnaires in person
making the questionnaires anonymous
providing return envelopes
trialling the questionnaire on friends

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO pieces of advice does the tutor give John about his questionnaire?

options.t: There should be a mixture of question types.
Some questions should elicit personal information.
There should be an introduction to explain the survey's purpose.
A telephone number should be provided for queries.
The questions should only take a few minutes to answer.
